description: This file contains unit tests for the AdoNetBatchContainer class in the Orleans streaming AdoNet provider. It tests construction, serialization/deserialization, event filtering, request context import, and string representation of the container, as well as defining test models used within the tests.

classes.name: AdoNetBatchContainerTests
classes.description: Unit test class for AdoNetBatchContainer, testing its construction, serialization, event filtering, and string representation.

classes.name: TestModel
classes.description: A record type used as a sample event in tests, with serialization attributes.

classes.description: Another record type used as a sample event in tests, with serialization attributes.
